pairs.evidence: src/components/cli/useTaskQueue.ts:162 The stored Claude thread id is silently replaced by whatever session id the child reports on connect, so a fresh-session Retry after a crash or timeout, or a resume the CLI quietly started fresh, unbinds the live thread with no gone/poisoned classification, no lineage record and no fresh-thread flag shown to the user.

techniques.evidence: src/components/cli/useTaskQueue.ts:162 Rules 1 and 4 fail: any new session id overwrites the bound one. No lineage, no comparison with the requested resume id, no re-thread notice (a grep for lineage/previousSession/resumedFrom over the CLI path finds nothing).
src/components/cli/useTaskQueue.ts:579 Run success is read from the envelope's error flag, not from the exit code alone. Narrow point: the shell consumes an already-normalized result.
src/components/cli/useTaskQueue.ts:770 The shell only POSTs to the server route that spawns. Probing belongs to the server-side spawn door (cli-service.ts, outside this context).
